projectReleaseDecision.basis: Faithful scans of public-domain visual art, limited to the reviewed storefront allowlist. The decision does not cover other territories, modern editions, card backs, icon, packaging, trademarks, or unrelated assets.

records.title: Rider-Waite-Smith tarot card artwork, TaionWC Pam-A scan set of the original edition
records.scope: The 78 TaionWC Pam-A scans mapped below. No card back, packaging, guidebook, modern restoration, recoloring, typography, trademark use, or commercial edition is included.

jurisdictionNotes.unitedStates: The U.S. Copyright Office states that works published in the United States before January 1, 1931 are in the public domain as of 2026. This does not independently verify the publication history or separate rights in each source file.
jurisdictionNotes.unitedKingdom: The underlying artwork is outside the ordinary term. UK IPO guidance states that a simple faithful digital reproduction is unlikely to meet the originality threshold for a new copyright.
jurisdictionNotes.europeanUnion: Article 14 of Directive (EU) 2019/790 excludes new copyright and related rights in faithful reproductions of public-domain visual art unless the reproduction is itself an original intellectual creation. Spain transposed that rule in Article 72 of Royal Decree-law 24/2021. This manifest approves Spain only; other EU storefronts remain outside the allowlist.

prohibitedAssumptions: A modern edition is safe because it depicts the original RWS composition.
A Commons public-domain label alone clears every intended App Store territory.
A scan, restoration, recoloring, crop, border, card back, or typography has no separate rights.
The Rider-Waite-Smith name, packaging, or commercial presentation is cleared by the age of the original illustrations.

sourceSets.title: Rider-Waite-Smith tarot deck (TaionWC), Pam-A
sourceSets.notes: Commons describes this category as scans of the Pam-A version uploaded as one image set. All 78 API records declare Pamela Colman Smith, 1910, Public domain, CC-PD-Mark, and PD-old-80-expired. The project decision is limited to US, GB, and ES and does not assert worldwide clearance.
